faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by Gun Carriage Factory Jabalpur (GCF) to fill vacancies for Skilled Tradesman positions in defence sector.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for the post of Skilled (Experienced) Tradesman (Fitter Electrical/Electronics) under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess NTC/NAC or Engineering Diploma/Degree in relevant Trade/Field with at least 02 Years' Experience from recognized institutes to be eligible for this job.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 18 and 35 years of age as on the last date of receipt of application. Age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 31,840/- per month, which includes basic pay and applicable DA at 60%.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UR and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for Unreserved (UR) and OBC category candidates is Rs. 200/- INR, payable through online mode during submission.

faq.question: Q7. Are SC, ST, and female candidates exempted from the fee?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to SC, ST, PWD, and female categories are completely exempted from paying the application fee for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply exclusively through online mode by visiting the official registration portal. No offline applications will be accepted by the factory.

faq.question: Q9. What is the last date to apply for GCF Tradesman recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 15 days from the date of publication of the official advertisement in the employment newspaper.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on essential technical qualification marks followed by a comprehensive Trade Test or Personal Interview.
